blocks.text: The shark stranded for more than a month in a canal at Busan’s North Port may have only two weeks to live, a marine expert has warned. The three-meter-long dusty shark, named “Bukang-i,” was seen slamming its head into the canal wall on Monday, according to local media outlet SBS. Footage taken by visitors the previous day also showed that the tip of its right pectoral fin had turned white and appeared injured.
